thread:
ash: Noticing a spike of 403s from auth-proxy after the RBAC update. Root errors show InvalidAudience and KMS context_mismatch on service tokens. Anyone seen similar?
maria: Saw alerts too. Can you paste a log sample and which IdP we talk to?
ash: Log: `2026-04-07T08:12:11Z auth-proxy ERROR req=9f1a user=carol@example.com idp_err=InvalidAudience aud="https://console.redwood.example.com/v1" svc_err=KMSDecryptError: context_mismatch alias="alias/redwood-main"`
oliver: We rotated alias/redwood-main last week. Rotation metadata looks normal but SCIM connector changed attribute mapping overnight. Could be a field-case mismatch (ExternalID vs externalId).
jamie: Quick audit: `SELECT count(*) FROM scim_events WHERE payload->>'externalId' ~ '[A-Z]' AND created_at > now() - interval '48 hours';` -> 9 rows, 2 svc accounts.
maria: If tokens are minted with mixed-case externalId in the encryption_context, and KMS expects lowercase, decrypt fails. For InvalidAudience, connector update may have changed audience string. Two separate regressions.
ash: Can we do a short-term shim in auth-proxy: on KMS context_mismatch, try alternate externalId normalization (lowercase) before failing?
oliver: Safer to add shim in proxy rather than changing KMS policy. Add a feature flag and canary 5%. Also add legacy audience acceptance for the SAML validator for a short window.
jamie: I'll open a tiny PR with `legacy_extid_fallback` and `legacy_saml_aud` flags. Will canary to staging then 5% production if green.
maria: Also, start a backfill to normalize externalId for affected teams and enqueue re-minting of service tokens. Don't forget to flush RBAC caches after backfill.
ash: Created INC-2026-118: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-118 — assigned to jamie, oliver, maria. sec-bot please attach KMS rotation and SCIM deploy audit logs.
sec-bot: KMS audit: alias/redwood-main rotated -> key=baadf00d at 2026-04-06T22:10:00Z. SCIM audit: connector v2.5.0 deployed 2026-04-07T01:05:00Z changed mapping for ExternalID casing.
oliver: Plan confirmed: (1) Jamie deploys shim to canary. (2) Maria runs backfill normalization + token reissue for svc accounts. (3) Flush RBAC caches. (4) Follow-up RFC for SCIM canonicalization.
jamie: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood/auth-proxy/pull/411 — will report canary metrics in 20m.
ash: Thanks. Ping #eng-oncall for any regressions and I'll escalate asap.
sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-118 created, severity P2. Updates posted here.
